visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with curly hair stands in a brightly lit kitchen, holding a white and a black Zwilling electric grinder. She smiles at the camera, wearing a black shirt and a silver necklace. The background shows a kitchen with a stainless steel sink and appliances. (2) The scene cuts to a younger woman with long, dyed purple-grey hair tied in a ponytail. She is in the same kitchen, wearing a black Calvin Klein sports bra and black Adidas track pants. She holds the same grinders, looking at them with a smile. (3) The young woman holds the white grinder close to the camera, rotating it to show the brand name. She is laughing. (4) She opens her mouth wide and holds the white grinder above her head, pretending to let it grind salt/pepper into her mouth. She is laughing and moving her head back and forth. (5) A static shot displays the two grinders standing on a kitchen counter. Sparkle and flower stickers are overlaid on the screen along with variety-style text. (6) The young woman performs squats in the kitchen while holding the grinders out like weights. She then moves to a wall-sit position against a dark refrigerator. A hand from off-camera reaches in to place a magnet on her ear. She laughs and reacts to the cold sensation.
